posts.body_html:
Hi all,

Long time lurker, first time poster...

I purchased a "Leo Song" sibling from CalCarn last year. It doesn't get fully red on my roof deck but the lip turns a magenta and the veining inside is intensely red. The spring lids tend to be smooth but then the fall pitchers develop these wide frilly lids with beautiful veining. It may not be the real deal, but a fan of this fake Leo Song. Do the lids on your plant change with the seasons?

(pay no attention to the burnt leuco in the background... we have been fighting)

For some reason, this clone doesn't quite produce that amazing hood for me, but whenever anyone gets a division from me, it seems like months later they send me pics and their plants look just like pics in the cultivar description. What gives?!
Hehe, like this? Super proud of my Leo this year. The way it catches the light is soooo gorgeous. Looks like a big red head of lettuce! And man those lids are massive--especially striking when viewed from behind.
